preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly three lines: first line with three integers, second line with two integers, and third line with one integer.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: All input integers are non-negative and do not exceed 10^5.

preconditions.expression: any(int(x) > 0 for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: At least one input Hamming distance is positive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == 5 and all(len(line) == int(stdout.splitlines()[0]) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' if no solution exists, or a valid set of four strings of equal length (first line is the length, followed by four strings).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda: (lambda s1, s2, s3, s4: all(h(s1, s2) == int(x) for x in [stdin.split()[0], stdin.split()[1], stdin.split()[2], stdin.splitlines()[1].split()[0], stdin.splitlines()[1].split()[1], stdin.splitlines()[2].split()[0]]))(*[stdout.splitlines()[i] for i in range(1, 5)]))()
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the four strings must have the same pairwise Hamming distances as the input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda: (lambda s1, s2, s3, s4: all(c in 'ab' for s in [s1, s2, s3, s4] for c in s))(*[stdout.splitlines()[i] for i in range(1, 5)]))()
postconditions.description: All characters in the output strings are either 'a' or 'b'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda: (lambda s1, s2, s3, s4: len(s1) == len(s2) == len(s3) == len(s4))(*[stdout.splitlines()[i] for i in range(1, 5)]))()
postconditions.description: All output strings have the same length.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda: (lambda s1, s2, s3, s4: len(s1) == min(len(s) for s in [s1, s2, s3, s4]))(*[stdout.splitlines()[i] for i in range(1, 5)]))()
postconditions.description: The output strings have the minimum possible length among all valid solutions.
